description: This file defines the Publisher class responsible for managing the publication of pages and content to a Confluence wiki within the Daux documentation generator. It includes methods for diffing, creating, updating, and managing pages and their hierarchy.

classes.name: Publisher
classes.description: A class responsible for publishing, diffing, and synchronizing pages to a Confluence instance as part of the Daux documentation system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Publisher with configuration, client, output, and width.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs an action with a given title and closure, managing common behaviors.

methods.name: diff
methods.description: Recursively compares local and remote page trees, outputting differences and changes.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Orchestrates the publishing process: finds the root page, fetches existing pages, optionally diffs, creates placeholders, and updates pages.

methods.name: rootNotFound
methods.description: Handles error case when root page cannot be found.

methods.name: configureSpace
methods.description: Sets the space context for the client based on a page.

methods.name: getRootPage
methods.description: Retrieves the root page based on configuration or creates it if missing and allowed.

methods.name: createPage
methods.description: Creates a new Confluence page at a given parent id with specific content.

methods.name: createPlaceholderPage
methods.description: Creates a blank placeholder page at a specified location.

methods.name: recursiveWithCallback
methods.description: Generic recursive method for traversing and modifying hierarchies with a callback.

methods.name: createRecursive
methods.description: Recursively creates pages from a nested structure.

methods.name: updateRecursive
methods.description: Recursively updates pages in a hierarchy.

methods.name: updatePage
methods.description: Updates a page if needed, and uploads attachments.
